# AstryxProgressBar { #anylumino.AstryxProgressBar }

```python
AstryxProgressBar(value=0, *, label, variant='accent', **props)
```

Render an Astryx progress bar.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Default    |
|---------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value   | int \| float | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `0`        |
| label   | str          | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| variant | str          | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `'accent'` |
| **props | Any          | JSON-safe ProgressBar props. Useful keys: max, isLabelHidden, hasValueLabel, variant, isIndeterminate, isDisabled, className, and style. anylumino manages label and value; variant supports accent, success, warning, error, and neutral. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ProgressBar>. | `{}`       |
